data.content: ["Surfside Beach offers a relaxed, low-cost coastal escape with excellent outdoor activities and food scenes, perfect for late-morning starts and leisurely days without the nightlife pressure.", "Clearwater Beach combines iconic Florida charm with strong food and outdoor offerings in a medium-cost setting that supports relaxed pacing and scenic walks away from clubs.", "Matagorda provides an ultra-affordable, quiet beach retreat with the highest outdoor focus (0.38) and minimal nightlife, ideal for your group's no-clubs requirement and slow-morning preference.", "Carolina Beach balances medium cost with solid food and outdoor vibes while maintaining a laid-back small-town atmosphere that avoids rushed schedules and nightclub scenes.", "Lincoln City offers a small-city alternative with balanced outdoor and food scenes, medium pricing, and a naturally relaxed vibe that respects late starts and provides scenic walks away from urban nightlife."]
